# THEUNOiA

> THEUNOiA LLP is a technology and software development company based in Maharashtra, India. We build websites, web apps, digital platforms, and custom software solutions for businesses and startups while empowering student makers.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.theunoia.com/): Overview of THEUNOiA, mission, services, products, and vision
- [Our Story](https://www.theunoia.com/story): The origin story of THEUNOiA, the question that started it, and the Ocean Theory
- [Team](https://www.theunoia.com/team): The makers, engineering departments, and leadership behind THEUNOiA
- [Hivh](https://www.theunoia.com/hivh): Community hosting workshops, awareness drives, meetups, and campus visits across 16 cities
- [Hunhar](https://www.theunoia.com/hunhar): Student-first freelancing ecosystem connecting emerging talent with real client projects
- [Blog](https://www.theunoia.com/blog): Editorial insights, technical articles, freelancing guides, and updates
- [Contact](https://www.theunoia.com/contact): Inquiries, project estimates, phone (+91 63742 14583), and email (howdy@theunoia.com)
- [Become a Maker](https://www.theunoia.com/become-a-maker): Application portal for student engineers, designers, and creators
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.theunoia.com/privacy): Data protection practices, contact form storage in Supabase, and user privacy rights
- [Terms of Service](https://www.theunoia.com/terms): Service terms, client deliverables, intellectual property, and warranties
- [Refund Policy](https://www.theunoia.com/refund): Milestone payment structures, cancellation terms, and warranty remediation

## Products & Ecosystem
- **Hunhar**: Student freelancing platform where businesses post projects and skilled student makers submit proposals within transparent budgets.
- **Hivh**: Grassroots youth community active across 16 cities fostering real-world technical skills and creative collaboration.
- **Client Solutions**: Bespoke web applications, custom software architecture, digital platforms, and design systems for startups and enterprises.
